copyright_policy.release_notice: No candidate is an approved brand asset or a licensed release asset. M10-03 must create a selected original master and record its final authorship, rights and license basis.

selection_gate.maintainer_selection: Valery Ledovskoy explicitly selected candidate 01, Workshop Beacon.
selection_gate.required_m10_03_refinement: Remove the non-final circular enclosing device from the monochrome icon direction. Retain an independent bear-with-modern-glasses silhouette.
selection_gate.release_block_reason: Workshop Beacon is selected only as the M10-03 design direction. Its preview remains unlicensed and cannot enter a release artifact before M10-03 creates approved original assets and records their rights.

generation.provenance_basis: Each preview was generated from its separately recorded original prompt. No Firefox, Mozilla, third-party, or personal photographic artwork was used as an input or reference.

candidates.name: Workshop Beacon
candidates.visual_direction: Warm forest-green and copper editorial mascot system with a centred friendly bear, slim round glasses, and calm, professional welcome desk scene.
candidates.primary_mark_direction: Forward-facing bear head with slim contemporary glasses and confident broad shapes.
candidates.monochrome_icon_direction: Dark single-colour bear-and-glasses silhouette intended for 16 px study; its enclosing presentation circle is explicitly not approved for a final icon.
candidates.welcome_onboarding_pose: A relaxed bear at a desk gently presents a neutral learning card about browser use.
candidates.illustrative_style: Warm textured editorial illustration with restrained product-design geometry.
candidates.generation_prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: preview-only Good Bear visual-branding candidate board, not production artwork. Create one original visual system for the independent desktop browser Good Bear: a text-free three-panel board with a primary calm intelligent adult bear head in slim contemporary round glasses; a simplified monochrome 16px bear icon direction; and a welcome onboarding bear at a small desk gently presenting a neutral internet-learning card. The bear is broadly sturdy but not a portrait or literal likeness. Use flat geometric editorial illustration, deep forest green, warm oat, muted copper and charcoal. No text, watermark, flags, government symbols, certificates, locks, shields, foxes, Firefox/Mozilla artwork, flames, rings, orbit compositions, or security-state claims.
review_flags: The generated round presentation frame around the monochrome study must be removed rather than carried into any final icon; final M10-03 artwork requires a distinctiveness review.

candidates.monochrome_icon_direction: Black bear-head-and-glasses silhouette without an enclosing container, intended to be simplified further at 16 px.
candidates.welcome_onboarding_pose: The bear walks beside an open notebook and points to an abstract dot-and-line learning path.
candidates.illustrative_style: Layered paper-cut collage and linocut texture with structured, adult editorial forms.
candidates.generation_prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: preview-only Good Bear visual-branding candidate board, not production artwork. Broadly sturdy but never a person likeness. Use highly original paper-cut collage and linocut-inspired vector-like art in midnight navy, mineral blue, warm cream, muted brick red and black.
